{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Verify the response rates by explicitly counting
control_responded = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].sum()
treatment_responded = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].sum()

control_total = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'control'].shape[0]
treatment_total = trial_df[trial_df['arm'] == 'treatment'].shape[0]

control_response_rate = control_responded / control_total
treatment_response_rate = treatment_responded / treatment_total
treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

# Print the detailed counts and rates
treatment_effect, control_response_rate, treatment_response_rate, control_responded, control_total, treatment_responded, treatment_total"}
